description_en: Queries the task list in the task center
description_zh: 查看任务中心的任务列表
name: DescribeHistoryTasks

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the pending event. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473763.html to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 待处理事件所属的地域ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473763.html查询
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，取值：10~100。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the query results. Valid values: positive integers. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 查询结果的页码。取值范围：正整数。 默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The task status. This parameter is used to filter tasks by status. Valid values:
Scheduled: Waiting for execution.
Running: Running.
Succeed: Succeeded.
Failed: Failed.
Cancelling: Being stopped.
Canceled: Stopped.
Waiting: Waiting for the scheduled time.
The default value is empty, which indicates all statuses. To specify multiple statuses, separate them with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
任务状态，用于选择对应状态的任务：
Scheduled：等待执行
Running：执行中
Succeed：执行成功
Failed：执行失败
Cancelling：正在终止
Canceled：已终止
Waiting：等待预设时间
默认为空，表示全选，如需选择多个状态请用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. This parameter is used to query tasks for the specified instance. The default value is empty, which indicates no restriction. To specify multiple instances, separate them with commas (,). A maximum of 30 instances are supported
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID，用于查询对应实例的任务，默认为空，表示不限制。如需查询多个实例请用英文逗号（,）分隔，最多支持30个
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The task ID. This parameter is used to query tasks with known IDs. The default value is empty, which indicates no restriction. To specify multiple task IDs, separate them with commas (,). A maximum of 30 task IDs are supported
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID，用于查询已知ID的任务默认为空，表示不限制。如需查询多个请用英文逗号（,）分隔，最多支持30个
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en:
The task type. This parameter is used to query tasks of a specific type. The default value is empty, which indicates no restriction. Valid values:
ModifyInsSpec: Specification change or migration.
DeleteInsNode: Shard deletion.
AddInsNode: Shard addition.
HaSwitch: Primary/secondary switchover.
RestartIns: Instance restart.
CreateIns: Instance creation.
ModifyInsConfig: Configuration change.
To specify multiple task types, separate them with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
任务类型，用于查询特定类型任务情况，默认为空，表示不限制，取值如下：
ModifyInsSpec：规格变更或迁移
DeleteInsNode：删除分片
AddInsNode：增加分片
HaSwitch：实例主备切换
RestartIns：重启实例
CreateIns：创建实例
ModifyInsConfig：配置变更
如需查询多个请用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en: The earliest start time for querying tasks. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC). You can query data from up to 30 days ago
parameters.help_zh: 查询任务的最早开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间），最早支持查询30天前的数据
parameters.name: from_start_time

parameters.help_en: The latest start time for querying tasks. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC). The value must be later than the earliest start time of the task
parameters.help_zh: 查询任务的最晚开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间），需晚于任务的最早开始时间
parameters.name: to_start_time

parameters.help_en: The minimum execution duration. This parameter is used to filter tasks whose execution duration is greater than the specified value. Unit: seconds. Default value: 0, which indicates no restriction
parameters.help_zh: 任务执行耗时的最小值。用于筛选任务执行耗时大于此时间的任务，单位秒。默认0，表示不限制
parameters.name: from_exec_time

parameters.help_en: The maximum execution duration. This parameter is used to filter tasks whose execution duration is not less than the specified value. Unit: seconds. Default value: 0, which indicates no restriction
parameters.help_zh: 任务执行耗时的最大值。用于筛选任务执行耗时不小于此时间的任务，单位秒。默认0，表示不限制
parameters.name: to_exec_time

items.description_en: The task object in dictionary format

CallerSource.description_en: The request user ID. When callerSource is User, this value represents the user UID
CallerSource.description_zh: 请求用户ID，callerSource为User时代表用户UID

CallerUid.description_en:
The request source. Valid values: 
System: Automatically initiated by the system.
User: Initiated by a user
CallerUid.description_zh:
请求来源。 
System：系统自动
User：用户

CurrentStepName.description_en: The name of the current step being executed. An empty value indicates that the task has not started
CurrentStepName.description_zh: 当前执行的步骤名，如果为空代表任务未开始

DbType.description_en: The database type. The value is fixed as redis

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the task in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
EndTime.description_zh: 任务结束时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

InstanceType.description_en: The instance type. The value is fixed as Instance

Product.description_en: The product. The value is fixed as kvstore

Progress.description_en: The current progress. Valid values: 0 to 100

ReasonCode.description_en: The reason why the current task was initiated

RemainTime.description_en: The estimated remaining execution time. Unit: seconds. A value of 0 indicates that the execution is complete
RemainTime.description_zh: 预估剩余执行时间，单位秒，0表示已执行完成

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the task in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
StartTime.description_zh: 任务开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

Status.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:
Scheduled: Waiting for execution.
Running: Running.
Succeed: Succeeded.
Failed: Failed.
Cancelling: Being stopped.
Canceled: Stopped.
Waiting: Waiting for the scheduled time
Status.description_zh:
任务状态。
Scheduled：等待执行
Running：执行中
Succeed：执行成功
Failed：执行失败
Cancelling：正在终止
Canceled：已终止
Waiting：等待预设时间

TaskDetail.description_en: The task details. Different task types correspond to different outputs
TaskDetail.description_zh: 任务详情，不同taskType对应不同的输出

TaskType.description_en:
The task type. Valid values:
ModifyInsSpec: Specification change or migration.
DeleteInsNode: Shard deletion.
AddInsNode: Shard addition.
HaSwitch: Primary/secondary switchover.
RestartIns: Instance restart.
CreateIns: Instance creation.
ModifyInsConfig: Configuration change
TaskType.description_zh:
任务类型。
ModifyInsSpec：规格变更或迁移
DeleteInsNode：删除分片
AddInsNode：增加分片
HaSwitch：实例主备切换
RestartIns：重启实例
CreateIns：创建实例
ModifyInsConfig：配置变更

Uid.description_en: The user ID of the resource owner

PageSize.description_en: The maximum number of entries per page
PageSize.description_zh: 每页显示的最大记录数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of tasks that meet the query conditions, regardless of pagination
TotalCount.description_zh: 不考虑分页因素，满足查询条件的总任务数
